info.title: ahmadkimiyaz — scaffold Clean Architecture layers into the current solution.
info.description: Scaffolds a Clean Architecture + CQRS layer set (Name.Domain / Name.Application / Name.Infrastructure / Name.Api + tests) into the current solution. Usage: ahmadkimiyaz -projectName YourApp

options.name: --output
options.description:
Target directory (default: current).
Must contain a .slnx or .sln to add projects to.

options.name: -projectName
options.description:
Base name for the layers
(e.g. Shop -> Shop.Domain, Shop.Application, ...).
